Native PyFly lock resolves merged optional dependency graph.

dependency_adaptations.pydantic-ai: Pin 2.59.0 for qualified native SDK behavior.
dependency_adaptations.pydantic-monty: Pin 0.0.23; native scoped worker pools and explicit async snapshot dispatch preserve direct host-tool calls. Unsupported allocation ceilings fail explicitly.
dependency_adaptations.dev: Standalone dev extra is the native agentic-dev dependency group.
dependency_adaptations.all: Self-reference rewritten to pyfly and native agentic-* extras.
dependency_adaptations.relational: New agentic-relational extra composes agentic,data-relational for framework-owned SQLite/SQL storage.
dependency_adaptations.postgres: Use PyFly Data relational units, SQLAlchemy asyncio, Alembic, SQLite and PostgreSQL adapters; compose agentic,data-relational,postgresql. Native asyncpg minimum is 0.32.0 rather than standalone 0.30.0.
dependency_adaptations.mongodb: Replace standalone Motor/PyMongo connection ownership with PyFly Data Document and Beanie 2.2+ using native asynchronous PyMongo. Motor is intentionally removed; compose agentic,data-document.
dependency_adaptations.vectorstores-pgvector: Replace standalone asyncpg pools with PyFly Data relational transaction ownership and PostgreSQL adapters; compose agentic,data-relational,postgresql. Native asyncpg minimum is 0.32.0.
dependency_adaptations.evaluation: Preserve evaluation integration and add datasets>=5.0.1 explicitly for current Ragas dataset conversion.

postgres.treatment: Use PyFly Data relational units, SQLAlchemy asyncio, Alembic, SQLite and PostgreSQL adapters; compose agentic,data-relational,postgresql. Native asyncpg minimum is 0.32.0 rather than standalone 0.30.0.
